findings.title: Caller-provided AbortSignal is overwritten, breaking external cancellation
findings.evidence: The fetch call now always injects a new signal, so any existing 'options.signal' passed by callers is ignored and cannot cancel the request anymore.
findings.evidence_quote: const response = await fetch(url, { ...options, signal: controller.signal });
findings.recommendation: Preserve the caller's signal by composing it with the timeout signal instead of overwriting it, for example by using AbortSignal.any([options.signal, controller.signal]) when a caller signal is present, or by wiring the caller signal to abort the timeout controller.
